scripts.build: npm --workspace=frontend run build && npm --workspace=backend run build
scripts.test: npm --workspace=frontend run test && npm --workspace=backend run test && npm run test:contract
scripts.typecheck: npm --workspace=frontend run typecheck && npm --workspace=backend run typecheck && tsc -p tests/contract/tsconfig.json --noEmit && tsc -p tests/e2e/tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.lint: npm --workspace=frontend run lint && npm --workspace=backend run lint && eslint --config tests/contract/eslint.config.mjs tests/contract && eslint --config tests/e2e/eslint.config.mjs tests/e2e tests/fixtures playwright.config.ts
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run test
scripts.verify: npm run check && npm run build && npm run verify:gas-bundle && npm run test:e2e
scripts.skills:sync: npm run skills:sync:matt && npm run skills:sync:ui && npm run skills:sync:playwright
